Static code analysis is the process of examining source code without running it to identify security flaws, reliability bugs, and maintainability issues as early as possible. Static code analysis tools help development and QA teams enforce secure coding standards, reduce regressions, and keep delivery fast by catching issues directly in the IDE, pull request, and CI pipeline. Raxis determines the best amount of time for your company's code and assigns a security-focused former developer to analyze it for both general security and business-logic vulnerabilities. SonarQube is your teammate to enhance your development workflow and guide your teams, with thousands of automated Static Code Analysis rules in more than 25 programming languages and direct integration with your DevOps platform.
